title: Domain Change
content: Joinly has officially moved from Netlify to Vercel! 🚀

This decision wasn't an easy one, but it will help keep costs lower for the developers in the long run. Since Joinly is a passion project and isn't generating any income, reducing unnecessary expenses is important.
Everything you know stays the same. Same website, same features, just a new domain.

title: Permission Requirements
content: Joinly now requires you to have the MANAGE_SERVER permission in your server to use setup commands.
This change was made because you're managing your server's settings with Joinly, and it makes permissions more consistent across all setup commands.
